A clean dataset makes better insights

Required columns

Use anonymous reader tokens beginning with anon-. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Return date may be empty. Extra columns are rejected to help prevent accidental personal-data imports.

Return statuses: NOT_RETURNED, RETURNED_ON_TIME, RETURNED_LATE, UNKNOWN.

Segments: STUDENT, FACULTY, STAFF. Formats: Print, E-book, Journal, Audio, Media.

Column checks cannot guarantee that free-text fields contain no personal information. Anonymize your export before uploading.

Activity history

Account access, approvals, and import outcomes. Reader data, passwords, and file contents are never included.

Import state history

Staff account approvals

Verify the person’s identity and requested role before approving. Faculty access is limited to the requested subject. Administrator approval grants account-management permissions.
